analysis:
Reviewed all five primary analyses and independently checked the replayed patches, metadata and changelog. MediaIngest.swift head:774–777 expands the exact inline-video header allowlist with video/mov and video/x-m4v; head:798 preserves case-insensitive matching, and the following path still passes maxMediaDecodedBytes to dataFromDataURI. These aliases alone do not establish a new parser, plaintext disk artifact or bypass. docs/architecture/inference.md head:810–815 documents presentation-order indexing using nominalFrameRate and newly admitted variable-frame-rate video. Its patch retains decoded-frame/prepared-pixel caps and media exclusion from prefix reuse, relevant to A-001, TB-007 and T-041. No supplied change establishes a regression in authorization, attestation, hop encryption, billing or privileged-helper authority.
The local questions converge on one unresolved implementation boundary: libs/mlx-swift-lm head:1 advances the dependency from 7bed821 to 54227ba, but no dependency implementation diff is supplied. Review that revision's GLM5NextProcessor.decodeAsset, GLM5NextVisionBudget and MemoryBackedVideoAsset interactions with MediaIngest: finite positive rate validation, frame-scan/decode bounds and cancellation, conservative reservations under VFR indexing, byte-based container validation, external-reference rejection, and memory-backed plaintext ownership. These are material to T-050/A-001 and availability (including T-010); documentation is not proof of enforcement, nor is absent source proof of a missing control. The reported threat-model alignment at docs/threat-model.yaml:1969–1972 cannot be independently checked because that source is omitted from replay. Replay is incomplete, so this result does not clear the dependency update or claim a full audit. No independently supported finding remains; targeted dependency review is still required.
